run_training_pipeline: run the PyTouch training pipeline with Hydra config overrides for model, data, and optimizer
instantiate_model_from_config: instantiate a PyTorch Lightning model from a Hydra config dictionary using hydra.utils.instantiate
configure_model_checkpointing: configure a ModelCheckpoint callback to save top-k checkpoints monitored by validation loss
